nodes.label: docs/canon/NEW_SESSION_PROMPT.md — the starter prompt for a session that works the record with the user

The whole starter is one line: "Work docs/canon/CONTRADICTION_MAP.md with me." Everything else a session needs — the intent/state/interpretation split, the citation rule, the layers, who rules — is in CLAUDE.md, which loads on its own. If a session behaves as though it did not know one of those, CLAUDE.md is what gets fixed, not this file
